steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: How are they?

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: That leader girl got slashed from behind by the bandits. Still out for the moment.

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: That many, all sneaking up on one woman at once. Cowards!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: S—So what now?

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: What do you mean what now? Those thieves were after our medicine, so they want us dead!

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: I'll take them on if it comes to that, my life against theirs! I can use Arts myself...

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: They live by getting one over! We couldn't even light a flame if we wanted. Taking them on would never get anywhere...

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Even if it wouldn't, we've got to! You saying you want those bloodthirsty cutthroats to make off with our medicine, after we barely managed to buy it?

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: All our efforts just to buy this one cheap measly lot of suppressants! And I want you to imagine, if it wasn't for them, then you, me, the village at large, how long we'll still be alive for all these damn stones in us!

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Not to mention, there's Rhodes Islanders with us...

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: But Rhodes is only here to deliver the drugs!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: You get it straight. Once they put the drugs in our hands, they could go at any time. They wouldn't help us!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: And even if they did stay... You've seen how badly the leader got hurt, after how easily she dealt with the beasts. Now it's just those girls left—what do you think they're going to be able to do?

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: The bandits aren't going to just forgive and forget after failing to steal our drugs. They might attack again at any moment!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Better we give them whatever they want. Better than dooming us all. We—We can always figure out something else!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Think carefully about this Rhodes Island or whatever. With how cheap they're selling it, who knows if the drugs are real or fake...

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Enough! You can shut up any day!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Erk.

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: I didn't hear this lousy tune from you when those girls helped us fend off the beasts AFTER dropping off the medicine, or when that doctor girl gave you an examination!

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: You think the measly amount we forked over was worth them delivering it all the way out here, and bringing a doctor to do checkups free of charge?

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: If that's the lengths Rhodes Island will go to, then whether or not the medicine works, I'm still believing in them!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Tell me, then... You think we can actually protect these drugs?

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: We can only try.

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Now, enough. I'm going to help the Rhodes Islanders. You find something to busy yourself with.

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Fine. One of the girls asked me to help out this morning. Still a little work left to go. I'll fetch somebody else to come with.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Not good. This is totally not good, the way things are going.)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Captain's KO'd and hurt, treatment takes time, now all we've got is a DPS and also me, a weird support character without many use cases...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Wait, no, nononobad. This is a really serious situation, I can't talk about it like a game.)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (But... I mean, this is hard. This is a tough one...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: What's the sigh for?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Wgaagh!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Phew, uh, okay, it's you, Utage...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: In the flesh.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Please don't pop up behind me without warning like that, you're going to jumpscare me to death.)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (What are you, a ninja or something?)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Did I spook you? Soz.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Come on, though, I'm not some kinda ninja.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Wha? Huh?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (How did she know what I was thinking...?)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (It couldn't be... mindreading?!)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I don't have superpowers or anything, you're just, like, real easy to read, girl.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (You're kidding me. Can you really tell?)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Yeah, for real real.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Well, that's convenient, now I don't need to talk.)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hey, slow down, Kirara.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: It's not a conversation unless you say what you're thinking out loud.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Or, like, what, do you want me to just stare at you forever? Hmm?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Okay, joke's over.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I'm gonna go check up on Akafuyu. See ya in a bit~

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Hold on, Utage!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I'm coming with you.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: So, uh, Utage... what do you think about the situation we're in right now?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Um... pretty messed up, I guess.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: We were expecting a normal delivery mission, right? So, not like we prepared that much.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: We did get a team put together...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Buuut the captain was our big hitter, and she left a whole opening to get backstabbed in.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Haaa...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I have no laughs in me right now.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Usually, average bandits aren't, like, a match for us at all, but they've got way too many guys. Kind of out of my league, if I had to solo them.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Our doctor's not gonna do combat, and you...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Don't look at me, I'm a Logistics techie.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, word? I always feel like every tech I know's pretty good in a fight.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Besides, you were good at those strategy games, weren't you? And you and the Doctor broke some kinda record one time? So, like, maybe being a commander's your thing.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: What do you think? Wanna try?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You're joking, real life isn't a video game, I... I can't.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: We should probably go see how Akafuyu's doing.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Aww... it's a bad habit to casually shoot yourself down.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Besides, you've totally got ideas going, don't you?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So hard to be honest, Kirara.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: The wound won't pose much issue, and we've applied anti-inflammatory.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: She still hasn't come around, but as long as she's not got a fever, then she should be out of the woods after convalescing properly.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Oh, okay...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: That's great to hear.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: But, like, how much longer is our captain gonna sleep for?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: That's up to Akafuyu's own constitution. We've given her all the treatment we can, but the wound was very deep...

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Even if she does wake up, she can't return to combat straight away.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hmm? We can't just wave her in anyway?

steps.name: Honeyberry & Kirara
steps.text: No!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: The sensors I laid out indicate those bandits have been in the area the whole time. We did get in touch with a nearby squad, but it's still gonna be a while before they get here.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: If the bandits attack now, while the time is ripe, I think we might...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Might be done for.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So now what? You think we take the captain and retreat?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Wait, if we go, what about the Infected here?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: We've delivered the medication, so that's mission complete, but I can't just leave the villagers for dead.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hmm... we take the medication too?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Okay, putting aside whether or not they'd buy that as a ruse, I think the bandits are after more than the meds anyway. They can fight the people here, and they have literally no way to fight back.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: That's true...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: So, uh...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Actually, I think we could—

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Excuse me, I've brought you all some food...

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: A little place like ours doesn't have much, so if you can just put up with it.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Thank you, it's kind to worry about us. Was anyone from the village hurt in the previous attack?

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: We're all fine, thanks to your group.

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Can I ask how your captain's doing?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: No worries, she's not in danger now.

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Oh, okay, that's a massive relief!

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: Right, can't forget this too.

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: It's those topographic maps of the place you all wanted...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Huh? Topographic maps? I didn't hear anything about that.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: I didn't request any either... Did Akafuyu ask for them at some point?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: ...It was me.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Thanks.
The voice of gratitude is near-inaudible.
Silent since the villager entered the room, the girl seems in a rush to dodge all lines of sight, dropping her gaze to the maps she now holds.
Being hand-drawn by the Infected of the wild settlement, they are rough and crude, no more than a few abstract lines drawn as hints in parts; they could hardly amount to real topographies.
Absorbing correct information from maps like these would be far from easy.
But grasping them tight, the Higashinese girl comes off like a truly experienced hand, rapidly flipping through the sheets.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Mmhuh...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Majorly flat terrain, very disadvantageous to us.)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (But there's places here to exploit for sure... like here. If we can do a little setup here...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (The plan works, it's feasible. But...)

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: So? Did you work something out?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Attagirl, Kirara~ Look at you, you got something brewing in your head, don't you?

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: What?! Really? Girl, you... no! Miss, you have an idea?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: ...I think we...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Uh...

steps.name: Listless Guy
steps.text: What did she even wanna say? She was just stammering. Say something or get off.

steps.name: Listless Guy
steps.text: Just wasting time... You can't even hear how quiet she talks!

steps.name: Caustic Girl
steps.text: I know, right? I heard in seventh grade, she was absent, uh, so much she almost repeated. She never showed up to class. Everyone thought she did something to make the school suspend her, like literally, everyone.

steps.name: Caustic Girl
steps.text: *snort* Apparently she likes those little plastic figures too. What if she was just secretly doing something, like, gross at home? Wow... creepy.

spans.text: *snort* Apparently she likes those little plastic figures too. What if she was just secretly doing something, like,

steps.name: Gossipy Student
steps.text: And her name totally doesn't fit, right? Like, you know you see it and you think Kirara, like she's gonna be this sparkly kinda pretty girl? But actually, she's just Kirara the weird downcast depresso. Such a buzzkill.

steps.name: Gossipy Student
steps.text: Her face? She never even lifts her head, who knows what her face is like...?

steps.name: Anxious Teacher
steps.text: Kirara, the school has resolved that we can't tolerate you being absent from class again like last year.

steps.name: Anxious Teacher
steps.text: If you can't adapt to school life, we may have to consider getting in touch with your parents about you repeating a year, or even withdrawing from school entirely...

a.text: Stop looking at me like that.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I, I d... I don't know...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (I can't breathe...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (What am I doing? Just say your words, come on, you're not at school here...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Uh, ah... I'd like to suggest—

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: B—Bad news!!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: The bandits! The bandits are back! They're surrounding the entrance, they've hurt some of us too...

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: What?!

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: There's wounded? Where? I need you to take me there immediately!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Guess that's that. I'm coming too.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hey, Kirara.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Don't keep us waiting too long.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Freaking Utage talking, it's like she understands everything.)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (What's the deal? I haven't figured this out myself yet...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (No, I can't just stand here like an idiot, I've got to do something or other and it's simple as that!)
Urgh...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Eek!
Don't make such a fuss.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Ssss... owowow, I can feel my wound.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Akafuyu?! You're up?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: How's your wound, are you okay? D-D-D-Don't move! Quick, lie down!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Just lie back down, I'll call for Honeyberry right away—

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Come back, you needn't call anyone!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: I can hold on... I actually awoke quite a time ago, and I heard everything you talked about. No great issues press me—my body simply wouldn't heed me somewhat.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: If the bandits that assaulted me have delivered themselves to me, then good! Watch me cut them down!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Ourgh!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Tsss...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: No, okay, great issues are extremely pressing you!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Quit moving! Aaaahh okay okay your wound's bleeding again... Stay still, put the katana down!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You're in no condition to fight right now, at all, whatsoever! You think you're some kinda fighting game protag? As long as your health bar's not empty yet you're completely unaffected, is that it, huh??

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Tch... There, you can talk quite fine, can't you.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: What do we do, then? If I cannot go, I fear Utage will buckle before long.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Are you saying you have some plan?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I—I've come up with it, kind of, but...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I don't think I can do it...

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Fool. What is it you're so afraid of?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: What? I'm not...

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: You are.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Out with your ideas! I will judge as the captain whether or not they work!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: On what basis do you say you can't do it? These squad members were handpicked by me. Are you saying I could not discern properly?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Wait, wait, I didn't I wasn't... You're twisting my words against me!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Yes, indeed. What is it? If you have objections, speak and let me hear.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Nnnnrgghh—)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (What the hell is her deal—!)

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: I see you as quite the strategizer. I've never bested you once in that regard!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: But those were games...

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Split no hairs. I recall you also discussed tactical command with that Doctor at one point?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: But that was on the topic of games too!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: And they've taught you plenty applicable in practice, no?!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Enough tarrying! Eyes wide! It's simple as this: will you do it?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: I've told you that I am the one who will judge here! I am your general in this moment, and you are my counsel. Now hasten in offering your advice!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Huff... hah...

steps.name: Listless Guy
steps.text: What... even... stammering...

steps.name: Listless Guy
steps.text: ......hear how quiet...

steps.name: Caustic Girl
steps.text: ...absent......did something...

steps.name: Caustic Girl
steps.text: ...likes those......secretly...

steps.name: Gossipy Student
steps.text: ...totally doesn't fit......weird downcast... buzzkill...

steps.name: Gossipy Student
steps.text: ...who knows... like...

steps.name: Anxious Teacher
steps.text: ...school has resolved...

steps.name: Anxious Teacher
steps.text: If...

a.text: I don't care what people say, I don't give a care...
Yeah. Yeah, okay. Didn't I already decide?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Deep breath)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I'll talk, I'll freaking talk okay?! Stop making this scene such a big emotional deal, does it seriously not embarrass you when everything starts hitting you like lines from a visual novel?!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I'll say it, I'm totally gonna say it!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I think we can—

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Someone else is hurt! Please get the wounded over to me, faster!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Sorry, but I can't hold them off for too long either. We're gonna get surrounded like this.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Seriously, are our drugs worth this much?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Compared to other medications on the market, we sell really cheap... and the efficacy's guaranteed.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, so that's why we send a whole squad on deliveries all the time.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: It's not just an issue of money. Medications like these are difficult to buy on the market period, so...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: That's why there's Infected among the people robbing too.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Isn't there anything we can do...?

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: O—Oh, right! That pink-haired girl had me set up a machine earlier! Is there something we can do with that?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Machine?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: I didn't hear anything about that.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Me neither.

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: I think I'm getting deja vu.

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: But...!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, if you wanna know about that...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Why don't we just make her explain it herself?

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Right, that's the Miss who asked us to do everything!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Phew... it's okay, I can do this, I can speak, it's okay...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: —Everyone, listen to me!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: I have a plan.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*...

steps.name: Boorish Bandit
steps.text: Found her! Over here!

steps.name: Boorish Bandit
steps.text: She's got all the drugs in her car! After her!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (...hah, they followed.)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (If the map was right, then around here there should be...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (No, wait!)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (I have to go further north!)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Phew...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Yep, okay, this is the area, this is some loose sand alright...!)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (We make the sand subside here, and form quicksand...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Great!)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Thank you, Originium Arts. I think I could kinda fill a mage role like this, huh?)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Done! Next. I just stall for time a little...)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Need to find a place to hide myself.)

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Where'd she go?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Where's she hiding? The car's still here. Get all the drugs out!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Hey, girl, can you hear me?!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Ran out with the goods all alone, huh? Thought you could get away on a fluke, or are you just trying to lure us out?

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: No matter your plan, it's nothing now!

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (What's the deal with this guy? He's a trash-talker.)

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: (Oh, if only I could tell him how every character who talks too much before a battle usually comes out of it pretty bad.)

steps.name: Boorish Bandit
steps.text: Hey! The med boxes here... they're all empty!

steps.name: Boorish Bandit
steps.text: We got tricked!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Heh... expected that. Looks like she just wanted to string us along.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Shame for you, though. You can pretend you're on your solo adventure, but we're not as stupid as you think.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: You know how many of us chased your bait? Less than half.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: The rest of us probably broke through that lousy Infected village by now, I'm reckoning?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Uh... wow, you really can talk.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Honestly, I'm kind of starting to envy the sheer confidence you've gotta have in order to talk at your opponent like you're straight up giving a speech.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Oh? Who knew that's where you'd be hiding... What, not gonna run?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Don't care to, anymore.

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Is it really going to work?

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: This is all we've got. If, just if, it doesn't do anything...

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: What's to fear?! You heard Kirara's plan yourselves! The feasibility is tremendous!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: And lest we forget, I'm present too! A wounded general is hardly a rare sight... *hiss*

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Stop showing off, Akafuyu!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Kirara already led a bunch of the guys away. The numbers on the rest...

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Mmhm, I think I should basically make it, even if we have issues.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: There you have it.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: I estimate she saw this too, hence why her arrangements are so?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Okay, then, no time to lose.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Everyone ready? Push the switch... 'eyy!

steps.name: Towering Bandit
steps.text: What... What is that?!

steps.name: Vicious Bandit
steps.text: That's a caster's Arts! Hey, are you suicidal? Pull out!

steps.name: Towering Bandit
steps.text: Where did they find so many casters...?

steps.name: Towering Bandit
steps.text: Urgh!!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Watch out, girl. Arts aren't the only danger on the scene.

steps.name: Vicious Bandit
steps.text: What the hell kind of trick are you pulling?!

steps.name: Vicious Bandit
steps.text: We've been watching the whole time! There's no way you found a caster to help—

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hm? Didn'tcha know? Infected can use Arts barehanded.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: You back these guys into a corner, and they can seriously do anything. You get me?

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Oh, heyyy, lucky, everyone's actually Infected here.

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Guess how many'd rather burst into dust in your face than let you get your way, huh?

steps.name: Vicious Bandit
steps.text: Maniacs!

steps.name: Crumbling Bandit
steps.text: These Infected are all insane! They're going to take us down with them!

steps.name: Crumbling Bandit
steps.text: Run for it!!

steps.name: Irritable Infected
steps.text: The bandits! They're beginning to retreat!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Really?! Oh, thank heavens...!

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Who knew this little box could be so much of a threat?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Good skies, didn't that work a little too well?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: H—Honestly!

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: When we pressed it and the sound of Arts firing suddenly went off all around, even I was jumpy!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Using a preconstructed projector to intimidate the enemy! Trust her to think of it...

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: And arranged so perfectly in such a short span of time. How did she possibly do it?

steps.name: Tense Infected
steps.text: Er, the pink-haired Miss asked us to install all these machines this morning.

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Pardon? This morning?

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Wait, when we'd just become aware of the bandits, before anything had even happened?!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: What in the stances did the Doctor teach her...?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Aaaand it's time.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: What did you do?!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: This pit... pteuch, she's trapping us!

steps.name: Boorish Bandit
steps.text: Help me! I'm going to get buried!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Girl! Don't you care if they live or die?!

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Even if you kill us all, the village is still—

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You just keep going...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: What I want is a perfect clear.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You wouldn't just ignore bait as obvious as me. Even if you didn't totally buy it, you'd at least send part of your people to follow, and that was enough.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: We trap a portion using me, a support who doesn't affect the big picture, which lowers your numbers, and back in the village we've got Utage for high attack, so they're pretty sure to handle it.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Not to mention the projectors...

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Wait, why am I explaining all this to you again?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Explaining your own plan is what antags do, and then they mess it up and they get comeback'd on. NG, NG.

steps.name: Shrewd Bandit
steps.text: What the hell kind of craziness are you talking to yourself about?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: You have a bind debuff, you don't get to interrupt!

steps.name: Utage
steps.text: Hiii, Kirara, can you hear me~

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Oi, Utage! No nonsense from you!

steps.name: Akafuyu
steps.text: Kirara, well done! We sorted things out handily on this side. How was yours?

steps.name: Honeyberry
steps.text: Kirara, you're not hurt, are you?

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: ...Heheh.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: No, I'm fine, I'm untouched. All good on my end too.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: Ahem.

steps.name: Kirara
steps.text: ...Just as planned.
